blocks.text: Nucleoproteins chromosomes ke DNA aur proteins ke darmiyan ionic bonds se bante hain. Maslan histone proteins DNA se jur kar nucleosomes banate hain. Yeh eukaryotes mein chromosome ki structure ko mazboot (stable) rakhte hain aur gene expression (genes ke kaam) ko control karne mein bhi aham kirdar ada karte hain.

blocks.caption: Aam conjugated molecules
rows: Membranes (structural), khoon ka serum, cell ke secretions (rutubat), cartilage, aankhen, jild
Tamam plasma membranes ka dhancha; khoon mein very low-density lipoproteins ke taur par lipid transport
Nucleosomes; chromosomes ko mazboot karte hain; gene expression control karte hain

blocks.prompt: Kaun se conjugated molecules covalent bonds ke baghair jure hote hain, aur kis qisam ki kashish se? Kitab ke mutabiq plasma membrane ka bunyadi dhancha kaun sa hai?
blocks.explanation: Lipoproteins hydrophobic interactions se aur nucleoproteins ionic bonds se jure hote hain; dono mein covalent bond nahin. Kitab ke mutabiq lipoproteins plasma membranes ka bunyadi structural dhancha hain, aur glycoproteins aur glycolipids membranes ke zaroori hisse hain.

items: Conjugated molecules mukhtalif qismon ke molecules ke milne se bante hain.

Glycoproteins (protein + carbohydrate, covalent) aur glycolipids (lipid + carbohydrate, covalent) membranes ke structural hisse hain; glycoproteins serum, secretions, cartilage, aankhon aur jild mein bhi hote hain.

Lipoproteins (lipid + protein, hydrophobic interactions) membranes ka dhancha hain aur khoon mein VLDL ki shakal mein lipids le jate hain; nucleoproteins (DNA + histones, ionic bonds) nucleosomes banate, chromosomes ko mazboot karte aur gene expression control karte hain.
